fields.description: Turns the committee guard on Quality Inspection / Purchase Order / RFQ on or off.
fields.label: Enable Committee Guard

fields.description: Above this amount (base), Purchase Orders / RFQs should carry assigned committee members; members record their decision on the document itself.
fields.label: Purchase Committee Threshold (ETB)

fields.description: A Material Issue (or a transfer for manufacture) out of an isolated enterprise store needs a Store Manager approval before it can be posted.
fields.label: Require Store Manager approval for isolated-store issues

fields.description: Every Material Transfer needs a Store Manager approval before posting.
fields.label: Require Store Manager approval for transfers

fields.description: Block a transfer between two different enterprises' isolated stores. A transfer into a mixed store stays allowed.
fields.label: Block cross-enterprise isolated transfers

fields.description: Daily job: notify the roles below for each item/warehouse at or below its reorder level. Never creates Material Requests.
fields.label: Enable reorder alerts

fields.description: Comma-separated AIG roles that receive the daily reorder alert.
fields.label: Reorder alert recipients (roles)

fields.description: Monthly reminder to Store Manager, per warehouse, to run a stock count.
fields.label: Enable monthly stock count reminder

fields.description: Day of month for the stock count reminder (1-28).
fields.label: Stock count reminder day

fields.description: Extra check on the existing 'Pending Enterprise Approval' transition: the approver must be the requester's closest boss (Employee Reports To) or hold the enterprise approval role. Switch off to fall back to role-only approval.
fields.label: Enforce closest-boss approval on stock requests
